title: "Show alternatives" popup partially overlaps horizontal panel when invoked from a widget at the edge of the panel
line: The Show Alternatives popup of a panel widget now opens fully outside the panel instead of partly under it.
explanation: The Alternative Widgets popup was a PlasmaCore.Dialog positioned against the widget's own rectangle, not against the panel. In a floating (or any) panel the widget sits inside the panel's padding, so the popup's lower edge ended up under the panel (and on a left panel, over its right edge). The popup is now a PopupPlasmaWindow, the same window type applet popups and the task manager group dialog use, which anchors to the panel's visible edge and keeps the floating-panel gap; it closes when it loses focus as before.

commits.message:
explorer: Place the widget alternatives popup outside the panel

The alternatives popup was a PlasmaCore.Dialog placed against the
widget itself, so in a floating panel its lower edge ended up under the
panel. Use a PopupPlasmaWindow like applet popups so it opens outside.

BUG: 489765

patches.diff:
From 33fc65a7610b9bdb917d5ab1e9f0adf456b72d06 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:30:01 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] explorer: Place the widget alternatives popup outside the
 panel

The alternatives popup was a PlasmaCore.Dialog placed against the
widget itself, so in a floating panel its lower edge ended up under the
panel. Use a PopupPlasmaWindow like applet popups so it opens outside.

BUG: 489765
---
 .../contents/explorer/AppletAlternatives.qml  | 32 ++++++++++++++++---
 1 file changed, 27 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/explorer/AppletAlternatives.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/explorer/AppletAlternatives.qml
index 7bc0a6bcc6..243d2694df 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/explorer/AppletAlternatives.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/explorer/AppletAlternatives.qml
@@ -17,22 +17,44 @@ import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 import org.kde.plasma.private.shell
 import org.kde.plasma.shell
 
-PlasmaCore.Dialog {
+PlasmaCore.PopupPlasmaWindow {
     id: dialog
 
     required property AlternativesHelper alternativesHelper
 
+    width: Math.max(root.Layout.minimumWidth, root.implicitWidth) + leftPadding + rightPadding
+    height: root.Layout.minimumHeight + topPadding + bottomPadding
+
     visualParent: alternativesHelper.applet
-    location: alternativesHelper.applet.Plasmoid.location
-    hideOnWindowDeactivate: true
-    backgroundHints: (alternativesHelper.applet.Plasmoid.containmentDisplayHints & PlasmaCore.Types.ContainmentPrefersOpaqueBackground) ? PlasmaCore.Dialog.SolidBackground : PlasmaCore.Dialog.StandardBackground
+    popupDirection: switch (alternativesHelper.applet.Plasmoid.location) {
+        case PlasmaCore.Types.TopEdge:
+            return Qt.BottomEdge
+        case PlasmaCore.Types.LeftEdge:
+            return Qt.RightEdge
+        case PlasmaCore.Types.RightEdge:
+            return Qt.LeftEdge
+        default:
+            return Qt.TopEdge
+    }
+    margin: (alternativesHelper.applet.Plasmoid.containmentDisplayHints & PlasmaCore.Types.ContainmentPrefersFloatingApplets) ? Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing : 0
+    removeBorderStrategy: alternativesHelper.applet.Plasmoid.location === PlasmaCore.Types.Floating
+            ? PlasmaCore.AppletPopup.AtScreenEdges
+            : PlasmaCore.AppletPopup.AtScreenEdges | PlasmaCore.AppletPopup.AtPanelEdges
+    backgroundHints: (alternativesHelper.applet.Plasmoid.containmentDisplayHints & PlasmaCore.Types.ContainmentPrefersOpaqueBackground) ? PlasmaCore.AppletPopup.SolidBackground : PlasmaCore.AppletPopup.StandardBackground
+
+    onActiveChanged: {
+        if (!active) {
+            dialog.close();
+        }
+    }
 
     Component.onCompleted: {
         flags = flags |  Qt.WindowStaysOnTopHint;
         dialog.show();
+        dialog.requestActivate();
     }
 
-    ColumnLayout {
+    mainItem: ColumnLayout {
         id: root
 
         signal configurationChanged
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: Show Alternatives on Peek at Desktop; the popup's bottom is hidden behind the floating panel
Zoom: the highlighted entry's lower edge disappears under the panel
With the fix: the popup opens fully above the panel
Zoom: the whole popup is visible with a gap above the panel, like Kickoff
